name: API Parcelles - Search by BBOX (GeoJSON, paginated, sortable, total)

parameters.query:
WITH inputs AS (
  SELECT
    $json.xmin::DOUBLE PRECISION AS xmin,
    $json.ymin::DOUBLE PRECISION AS ymin,
    $json.xmax::DOUBLE PRECISION AS xmax,
    $json.ymax::DOUBLE PRECISION AS ymax,
    $json.srid::INT AS srid
), env AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, srid) AS geom, srid FROM inputs
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS total
FROM cadastre.parcelles p, env
WHERE ST_Intersects(
  CASE WHEN ST_SRID(p.geom) = env.srid THEN p.geom ELSE ST_Transform(p.geom, env.srid) END,
  env.geom
);

WITH inputs AS (
  SELECT
    $json.xmin::DOUBLE PRECISION AS xmin,
    $json.ymin::DOUBLE PRECISION AS ymin,
    $json.xmax::DOUBLE PRECISION AS xmax,
    $json.ymax::DOUBLE PRECISION AS ymax,
    $json.srid::INT AS srid,
    $json.limit::INT AS lim,
    $json.offset::INT AS off,
    $json.sort::TEXT AS sort
), env AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, srid) AS geom, srid, lim, off, sort FROM inputs
)
SELECT p.id,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)) AS geometry,
       (to_jsonb(p) - 'geom') AS properties
FROM cadastre.parcelles p, env
WHERE ST_Intersects(
  CASE WHEN ST_SRID(p.geom) = env.srid THEN p.geom ELSE ST_Transform(p.geom, env.srid) END,
  env.geom
)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN env.sort='-id' THEN NULL ELSE p.id END ASC, CASE WHEN env.sort='-id' THEN p.id END DESC
LIMIT (SELECT lim FROM env) OFFSET (SELECT off FROM env);
